compose:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: app
      POSTGRES_DB: app
      POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:5432:5432"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pg_isready", "-U", "app"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 30
  broker:
    image: rabbitmq:3.13
    environment:
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER: app
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS: ${BROKER_PASSWORD:?set BROKER_PASSWORD}
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:5672:5672"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rabbitmq-diagnostics", "-q", "ping"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 30
